**q25.**
Engine: CEL (Common Expression Language) via `cel-go`, implemented in `internal/filter/engine.go` (line 14, `Engine` struct; `Compile` at line 48; `DefaultEngine` at line 111). Schema defining filterable fields is in `internal/filter/schema.go:89`.
Mechanism: The handler passes filter strings to the store; each dialect driver calls `filter.DefaultEngine()` and `filter.AppendConditions()` (from `internal/filter/helpers.go:9`), which compiles the CEL expression into an IR condition tree (`internal/filter/ir.go`), then renders it to dialect-specific SQL via `internal/filter/render.go:32` — handling SQLite, MySQL, and PostgreSQL placeholder styles, JSON access, and operators.

**q26.** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (directly via application code in `store/memo.go:140-158`), `memo_share` (via database-level `ON DELETE CASCADE` FK constraint on `memo_id`), plus recursively any comment memos and their associated records in the same tables.

**q27.**
Mechanism: `go:embed` — the compiled React `dist/` directory is embedded into the Go binary via `//go:embed dist/*` and served with Echo's `StaticWithConfig` middleware plus an SPA fallback.
File: `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` (embed directive at line 20-21, wired from `server/server.go:72`)

**q28.**
S3 Presign Runner — triggered by a 12-hour `time.Ticker` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`; started in `server/server.go:162-171`)

Unused infrastructure: The `internal/scheduler/` package implements a full cron-style scheduler but is **not imported by any production code** — no file outside `internal/scheduler/` uses it. The `server/runner/memopayload/` runner exists but is **not started as a background worker**; its `RebuildMemoPayload` function is called inline during memo create/update, not via a background loop.

**q29.**
Interceptor: `web/src/connect.ts` (lines 156-178, `authInterceptor` — a ConnectRPC `Interceptor`)
Token kinds: access token (short-lived JWT, stored in localStorage as `memos_access_token`, 15-min TTL) and refresh token (HTTP-only cookie named `memos_refresh`, 30-day TTL)
Backend validation package: `server/auth/` (`server/auth/authenticator.go` — `Authenticator` struct at line 26, validates access tokens as stateless HS256 JWT, refresh tokens against DB, and personal access tokens via SHA-256 hash lookup)

**q30.**
`memos.memo.created`: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15`)
`memos.memo.updated`: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:20`)
`memos.memo.deleted`: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:25`)
`memos.memo.comment.created`: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:30`)

All four converge on `webhook.PostAsync()` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, which enqueues into a buffered channel drained by worker goroutines that call `Post()` (line 120) for HTTP delivery.
